text:
anya: minor chaos report: Margot decided the fern pot needed a spa treatment and relocated half the potting mix to the living room. also brought a tiny rubber duck. evidence: imgur.com/xyzMargotSpa :duck: :leafy_green:

dave: this sounds peak content. pls deliver photos and a statement from the duck.

maria: statement: 'quack, the soil is fine.' :joy:

jules: i nominate Margot for Head of Facilities. that excavation indicates clear initiative and project management skills.

sam: vote: Head of Facilities and Interim Hydration Czar. can we add 'soil aesthetician' as an honorary title?

anya: adding to the org chart now. also snuck a 3s clip of her shimmying in the pot—uploading as margot_soak_3s.gif

dave: dropped it in the #pets-photos folder. also low-key think the duck is the true project manager.

maria: caption suggestions for Friday photo drop: 'When your dog insists on offering the fern a spa day' or 'Plant therapy, level: Margot.'

jules: 'plant therapy, level: Margot' is my pick. it's long enough for the top banner.

sam: tagging design for a tiny sticker: fern + duck + Margot silhouette. will pitch to merch.

anya: brilliant. thank you for the ideas and the emoji reactions. Margot approves (i.e., she chewed the duck's tail once). :blush:

dave: classic leadership onboarding behavior. congrats to Margot on her new role. :tada:
